ruleDefinitions.name: Copy .DMP/.DUMP Files From Remote Share Via Cmd.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the copy builtin cmd command to copy files with the ".dmp"/".dump" extension from a remote share

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\\\\\\\.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dump.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.hdmp.*"))))
